facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The automated trace was found in 20 of 20 slices and lies on the clicked layer, but with 34.5% within 2 voxels and 55.1% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 3.8 voxels it cannot be trusted as correct. Before the fix the agreement was better at 64.4% within 5 voxels with median distance of 3.3 voxels. It is weakest away from the yellow dot, with drift visible in slice 0 and in slice 19 where the red line follows adjacent bright material. A person should check the red line against the bright sheet in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19, looking for places where the trace jumps to a neighboring layer.
